title: Nonlinear Kinetic Diffusion Equations with $p$-Growth
summary: We establish the local boundedness of (sub-)solutions to nonlinear kinetic diffusion equations with $p$-growth, where the kinetic p-Laplace equation is a prototypical example. A key ingredient is the derivation of kinetic Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequalities, where the Lebesgue norm of a function is estimated in terms of its transport and diffusive directions controlled in different Lebesgue spaces.
